svg.text: Route 53 resolves *.example.com to the ALB (alias record).
Browser connects to the internet-facing ALB on :443 (ACM certificate).
AWS LB Controller programs host rules; ALB sends traffic straight to pod IPs.
React SPA calls api.example.com; API talks to the MongoDB replica set (mongo-svc).
PVC → StorageClass ebs-gp3 → EBS CSI creates a gp3 volume per AZ → PV bound, attached, mounted.
Prometheus scrapes nodes + kube-state-metrics today; API /metrics once added (dashed).
CI bumps the image tag in the manifests repo; Argo CD pulls and syncs voting-app + monitoring.
Controller ServiceAccounts assume scoped IAM roles via the OIDC provider (no static keys).
orange text = not in the repo yet
